Creamy Carbonara (No Egg)

Cassie Heilbron
A quick, creamy carbonara without eggs.
Prep Time 5 minutes mins
20 minutes
Servings 2
Main Course

Ingredients 

  • ▢200 g / 7 oz Penne Pasta
  • Salt for the pasta water
  • 1/2 cup Heavy Cream

Optional

  • Chopped Parsley

Instructions

  • Bring a large pot of water to boil, add a generous amount of salt. Reserve ¼ cup of pasta water.
  • Add the cream, pasta water and pasta.
